conviction_note: Q3 is mostly pre-guided (80% of days at US$25,257 blended, disclosed 30 Jul), so the move sits on the lines that are new: Q4-to-date fixtures, which peers' public Q4 books (TORM MR US$59,722, LR1 US$106,271; Scorpio MR US$56,000) say will print far above Equita's US$30,000 H2 spot assumption, and a Q3 interim dividend, for which last year's Q3 release set the precedent (+7.5% that day). Against that, the sector is selling good news (TORM beat and raised on 4 Nov and fell about 6%), so p_up is 57 and not higher. abs_move is 7, set by the verified prior prints (+7.5, -7.5, +4.3, +1.6). The findings sum (+2.5) is larger than the scaled number (+0.98) because the sum carries each finding at full size, while p_up carries the uncertainty about whether a peer-read-through result already priced across the sector still lifts the stock.

findings.finding: Peers' published Q4-to-date books imply that DIS's Q4 spot fixtures, new in this release, will print around US$50-65k/day for MR and higher for its 6 LR1s. Against that: TORM MR 49% at US$59,722 and LR1 38% at US$106,271; Scorpio MR US$56,000 on 47% and Handymax US$40,000 on 37%. DIS's Q3 spot was about US$30k, and Equita's H2 assumption is about US$30k spot, so FY26 profit expectations move up materially.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: the release carried Q4 coverage of 54% at US$23,492 and an interim dividend, and the stock rose 7.51% on the day (6 Nov 2025). Q2 2026: it guided a Q3 cooldown to US$25,257 blended, and the stock rose 1.60% on the day and fell 4.06% over two days. Q1 2026, which showed strong Q2 forward fixtures, rose 4.30%.
findings.why_not_priced: The peer read-through is public and sector-wide, and DIS rose 21% over 60 days. But the DIS-specific Q4 book, and how much of DIS's open fleet caught the spike given its ~55% time-charter cover, has not been published. Thin Italian coverage (5 analysts, Equita on US$30k H2 spot as of mid-September) has not visibly rebased: the stock is 5% below its 29 Oct level and trades near the €8.85 average target set before the Q4 spike. If the market had priced a US$50k+ Q4 book, DIS would not have given back the whole late-October move alongside peers.

findings.finding: The Q3 release is DIS's interim-dividend slot. The Q3 2025 release announced an interim gross dividend of US$0.1340/share (US$15.9m, ~25% of 9M profit), and 9M26 profit is likely about 1.7x 9M25 (H1 alone US$79.4m against 9M25 US$62.8m), so a larger interim dividend is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only precedent is 6 Nov 2025, when the interim dividend was announced with Q3 results and the stock rose 7.51% on the day and 16.56% over two days.

baseline_tension: The findings lean up, against a 5- and 20-day run-up that is negative (-7%, -8%) and a weakly positive priced lean (+0.39). The 5-day fall is sector-wide, not DIS-specific, and TORM's sell-the-news on 4 Nov is the one thing that argues the market is fading good product-tanker prints. That is why p_up stays at 57 and the scaled number (+0.98) is well under the findings' sum (+2.5).

The Italian versions of the results releases ('Comunicato Stampa') matched the English ones; there was no extra content in the domestic version.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide': the Q4-fixtures and FY26-outlook finding was resized on the guidance scale, +2.0 to +2.5, and abs_move_pct raised from 6.0 to 7.0 because a de facto outlook update is likely.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Q3 reported-quarter finding, which lands inside the company's disclosed 80% coverage, went from +0.2 to 0.0.
'Let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': the TORM sell-the-news and DIS's own sold prints stay in p_up (57, unchanged) and the -1.0 positioning finding; they do not cap the size.
'A truncated zero is not evidence nobody is short': positioning_check states anchor_covered false and makes no claim about short interest.
